RequireApproval.title: Require approval before sharing memory
RequireApproval.description: Always show the permission card before memory is shared, even when a standing grant exists for this AI app and profile.

MaxMemoriesPerRequest.title: Maximum memories per request
MaxMemoriesPerRequest.description: Upper bound on how many memories may be included in one shared context block.

DisableSemanticSearch.title: Disable on-device semantic search
DisableSemanticSearch.description: Restrict matching to keyword and category scoring. All matching stays on the device either way.

DisableGeneralFallback.title: Disable general-memory fallback
DisableGeneralFallback.description: When nothing matches a question, share nothing instead of filling the request with the strongest general memories.
